requirements.description: System shall authenticate users via username/password
System shall reject invalid credentials with HTTP 401
Protected endpoints shall return 401 without valid token
Employee shall be able to create a service request ticket
Ticket creation shall validate required fields
Ticket API response shall conform to JSON schema contract
Created ticket shall persist in database with correct FK relationships
Ticket status shall propagate across API and database layers
Non-existent ticket fetch shall return HTTP 404
All system roles (admin/agent/employee) shall log in successfully
API shall return correct Content-Type: application/json headers
Database shall be seeded with required categories on startup
Database shall be seeded with SLA priorities on startup
System health endpoint shall return HTTP 200
